approval: Independent final reviewer approves the fixed 157-report/24-media manifest and staged package. W&B publication, additive publication receipt and this approval record, then commit/push may proceed. No evidence content edits approved or required.
historical_adapter_review: Reviewed actual 107-line staged adapter; exact source and media checks, all exact clips retained, non-equivalent excluded, partial groups restricted to standalone attribution.

whitespace_check.judgment: Existing EOF blank lines and CSV CRLF/recorded whitespace are cosmetic; preserve hash-bound evidence byte-for-byte.

review_scope: Report claims/tables, final v3 joins/classes/coverage/revision, original and replay links, warning provenance, manifest contents, copied bytes and actual Git index. No simulations or publication performed by reviewer.
